args: Run /weekly-impact on ~/.gemini/config/plugin_data/wv-antigravity/memory/: summarize this week's completed [x] action items and initiative progress across Altitude 1 (Executive Outcomes), Altitude 2 (Reusable Assets), and Altitude 3 (Workstream Velocity), save weekly/YYYY-WXX.md, and append to impact/ledger.json.
description: Every Friday at 4:00 PM, compiles your 3-Altitude weekly accomplishment summary into weekly/YYYY-WXX.md and impact/ledger.json.
